debug_text.text: '[X4LAN] AUTH_TRADE_READ ACCOUNT faction=player faction_ct=%s player_ct=%s'.[(if faction.player.hasownaccount then (faction.player.money / 1ct)L else 'unknown'), (player.money / 1ct)L]

do_if.value: md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$epoch? and md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$faulted? and md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$ships? and md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$byship? and md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$last? and not md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$faulted

$index le md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$last and @$ship.isclass.ship and @$ship.isoperational and @$ship.idcode == $code and @$ship.owner == faction.player and @md.X4AuthorityShipRegistry.State.$byship.{$ship} == $index

debug_text.text: '[X4LAN] AUTH_TRADE_READ SHIP index=%s code=%s status=observed sector=%s docked=%s internal=%s dock_state=%s dock_host=%s free_units=%s cargo_units=%s'.[$index, $code, (if @$sector.isclass.sector then $sector.macro.id else 'unknown'), (if $dock.exists then 1 else 0), (if $ship.isinternallystored then 1 else 0), (if $dock.exists then $dock.dockstate else 'none'), (if @$dock.container.exists then $dock.container.idcode else 'none'), $ship.cargo.{$ware}.free, $ship.cargo.{$ware}.count]

'[X4LAN] AUTH_TRADE_READ STATION ship=%s source=%s code=%s macro=%s owner=%s distance_m=%s stock_units=%s'.[$code, $station_source, $station.idcode, $station.macro.id, $station.owner.id, ($station.distanceto.{$ship} / 1m)L, $station.cargo.{$ware}.count]
'[X4LAN] AUTH_TRADE_READ OFFER ship=%s station=%s status=observed units=%s unit_ct=%s'.[$code, $station.idcode, $offer.amount, ($offer.unitprice / 1ct)L]
'[X4LAN] AUTH_TRADE_READ OFFER ship=%s station=%s status=no_matching_offer units=unknown unit_ct=unknown'.[$code, $station.idcode]
'[X4LAN] AUTH_TRADE_READ STATION ship=%s status=unobserved stock_units=unknown offer_units=unknown'.[$code]
'[X4LAN] AUTH_TRADE_READ SHIP index=%s code=%s status=unverified sector=unknown docked=unknown free_units=unknown cargo_units=unknown'.[$index, $code]
